Hi! I'm Sofia. And this is my friend Gus.
Today we are going to the city center. It's my mom's birthday tomorrow. I need a present.
In this story, you will learn how to ask for directions, how to shop, and how to ask for help. Let's go!
Let's learn how to ask for directions and ask for help.
Okay, Gus. The city is very big. Please stay with me.
Yes, yes. I will stay with you.
Don't go far. Do you understand?
I understand. I'm not a baby. I'm a goose.
Oh, look! A flower shop. Mom loves flowers.
Wait here, Gus. I'll be back in two minutes.
Two for one? Two burgers for one price?
I have to see this. Just for one minute...
Where is the burger place? It was here... I think.
Hmm. This street is different. Where is the flower shop?
Okay. Don't panic, Gus. Take your phone. Call Sofia.
No, no, no! My phone is dead!
I'm lost! I'm a lost goose in a big city!
Okay. Calm down. I can ask someone for help.
Hmm. This is not a park. This is a shop.
Yes, please. Do you sell phone chargers?
Sorry, we don't. But we have maps.
A map! Perfect. How much is it?
I have... three dollars. And a coupon for burgers.
Sorry, the coupon doesn't work here.
Oh no. My card is at home.
Okay... Here's a small map. It's free.
Really? Thank you! You are very kind.
No problem. Where do you want to go?
Green Street. Next to Big Burger.
We are here. Green Street is here.
You went the wrong way. Turn left at the bank, not right.
Left. Of course. I knew that.
Excuse me, can I use your phone? I need to call my friend.
Hmm... I don't remember her number.
I know the burger menu by heart. But not her number.
Where is he? I said wait here!
The number you are calling is not available.
Oh no. His phone is dead. Again.
Excuse me, officer! Can you help me, please? I lost my friend.
Of course. What does your friend look like?
He is tall. He is white. He has a long neck and an orange beak.
A long neck and an orange beak?
And he's wearing a blue tie.
Miss... is your friend a goose?
No, no. Where did you see him last?
Here. Next to the flower shop. About twenty minutes ago.
Hmm. Is there a place he loves?
Go straight... turn left at the bank... past the park... Green Street! I did it!
Where were you? I was so worried!
I'm sorry. I smelled burgers. Then I got lost. Then my phone died.
I know. But I learned a lot today. I asked for directions. I went to a shop. I got a free map!
You asked for help in English? I'm proud of you.
Thank you. Now... two for one?
Okay. But this time you stay with me.
Now it's practice time! Listen and repeat after me. Ready?
Excuse me. Can you help me?
How do I get to Green Street?
Go straight. Turn left. Turn right.
Can I use your phone, please?
Quick question! At the bank, Gus turned right. Was that correct? Write your answer in the comments!
No. He needed to turn left.
Great job! Now you can ask for directions, shop, and ask for help in English.
